investments.title: Investments
investments.subtitle: Explore stocks, FIIs and other market assets
investments.searchPlaceholder: Search asset, e.g. PETR4, MXRF11, AAPL34...
investments.explanationStocks: Stocks represent small fractions of a company. When you buy a stock, you become a partner in the business and can profit from the share's appreciation over time or from receiving part of the profits (dividends).
investments.explanationFiis: Real Estate Funds (FIIs) pool resources from many investors to invest in the property market (malls, warehouses, office buildings). The main advantage is receiving monthly 'rent', usually income-tax free.
investments.explanationEtfs: ETFs are funds that replicate market indices (such as the Ibovespa or S&P 500), ideal for diversification. BDRs are receipts traded in Brazil that represent shares of large foreign companies (such as Apple, Google and Disney).
